title: Blog Article
description: A long-form article page: standfirst, prose rhythm, a contents rail, and the author card that earns the follow.
usage: The prose column is set for reading: a 17px body on a 1.85 line height inside a measure near 65 characters, headings that arrive like chapter breaks, and a contents rail that sticks on wide screens. Swap the article, keep the rhythm — the typography is the template. Figures are gradient stand-ins for your images, captions included because images without captions are decorations.
a11y: One h1, headings in order, and the contents rail is a nav with real anchor links. The byline gives the date in text, the read time is honest arithmetic, and code blocks scroll horizontally instead of breaking the measure.
